stories.title: Verdant Biosciences grows a functioning kidney organoid on a microfluidic chip
stories.summary: Verdant Biosciences reported that a kidney organoid cultured on its microfluidic organ-on-a-chip platform filtered a blood analogue for two weeks, a step the company said could reduce reliance on animal testing. Independent researchers called the result promising but early, and noted the device is not a transplantable organ.

stories.title: Helios Therapeutics reports durable results from an in-vivo gene-editing trial
stories.summary: Helios Therapeutics said a single in-vivo gene-editing infusion lowered a disease-linked protein for a year in an early-stage trial of a rare metabolic disorder. The company plans a larger study. Analysts cautioned that long-term safety data remain limited and the eventual price is unknown.

stories.title: Meridian Health Authority proposes tying new drug prices to measured outcomes
stories.summary: The Meridian Health Authority advanced a proposal that would pay for certain expensive therapies only when they achieve pre-agreed clinical outcomes. Industry groups warned the model could slow patient access; patient advocates said it would curb paying full price for treatments that do not work.
